capabilities: send heartbeats to the WakaTime or Wakapi API while browsing or writing notes
map folders and files to specific projects with a default project fallback
ignore specified files and folders from tracking
track PDFs and images in addition to Markdown files
configure the API key and a custom Wakapi URL
extras: The author solicits donations via Patreon, GitHub Sponsors and Liberapay; installation from GitHub releases is documented alongside Community Plugins.
intentEvidence: the official WakaTime plugin misses some features and makes it easier to set a custom URL
motivation: The author built it because the official WakaTime plugin misses some features and makes setting a custom URL (e.g. for a personal Wakapi instance) harder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in time tracking, and the official WakaTime plugin lacks options like custom API URLs and per-folder project mapping.

relations.evidence: inspired and in small parts based on the official Wakatime plugin

summary: Time-tracking integration that sends activity heartbeats from note viewing and editing to WakaTime or a self-hosted Wakapi instance.
